name: elmcn
description: shadcn/ui components for Elm, distributed as a shadcn registry

scripts.build: bun run docs:gen && bun run build:elm && bun run build:css && cp docs/index.html dist/ && cp -r docs/fonts dist/
scripts.check: bun run docs:gen && tsc -p . && elm-format src docs --validate && elm-review && shadcn registry validate && bun scripts/check-registry.ts
